title: Normalize float vector in native scorer test when using Cosine

timeline.message: Normalize float vector in native scorer test
timeline.author: ChrisHegarty

timeline.body:
This commit effectively normalizes float vector values in native scorer test, when using Cosine.

closes #111885

reply.body: randomFloat() returns values in the range 0.0f - 1.0f, so will not overflow the arithmetic when passed to `ScalarQuantizedVectorScorer::quantizeQuery` - which will do the normalisation.
Ok yes! I didn't notice it was using the scorer quantization, I thought it was calling scalar quantizer directly.
